content.title: About
content.content: Vegetable dip, yogurt based is a smooth sauce made from natural yogurt, fresh vegetables (cucumber, pepper, carrot, herbs) and seasonings. It has a light tang, refreshing flavor and creamy texture, making it perfect for snacks and light meals.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The yogurt base adds probiotics that support gut microbiota.
Vegetable content usually exceeds 30 % of the total weight, boosting its vitamin profile.
Commonly used in Mediterranean cuisine as a healthier alternative to sour cream sauces.
Low fat content compared to traditional dairy dips makes it suitable for calorie‑controlled diets.
Flavor can be easily varied by adding different herbs and spices.

items.title: Probiotics
items.content: Yogurt provides live bacterial cultures that promote digestive health.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: The vegetables contribute vitamin B6 and folate, important for metabolism.

items.title: Calcium and Vitamin D
items.content: Yogurt is a good source of calcium, supporting bone health.

items.title: Low in Saturated Fat
items.content: Compared with traditional sour‑cream based dips, this dip contains less saturated fat.

items.title: Antioxidants
items.content: Fresh vegetables are rich in carotenoids and vitamin C, which help combat free radicals.

items.title: Lactose Intolerance
items.content: People with lactose intolerance should choose lactose‑free yogurt or plant‑based alternatives.

items.title: Milk Allergy
items.content: Those allergic to dairy proteins may react to this dip.

items.title: Sodium Content
items.content: Some versions contain added salt; consumers watching sodium intake should check the label.

items.title: Limited Shelf Life After Opening
items.content: Once opened, keep the dip refrigerated and consume within 5‑7 days.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the dip with fresh vegetable sticks, crackers, flatbreads, or use it as a sauce for burgers, rolls, and casseroles. It can be mixed into salads for a creamy dressing or blended into mashed potatoes.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the dip in an airtight container in the refrigerator at 1‑4 °C. Do not freeze, as the texture may change. Discard if it develops an off‑odor or discoloration.
